Welcome to a captivating journey of cultural richness!

 It all started in 1948, when historic events brought the most treasured Chinese cultural wonders to Taiwan. Today, the National Palace Museum in Taipei proudly displays the magnificent culmination of artifacts from three former imperial palaces in Beijing, Rehe, and Shenyang.

Step into the allure of Chinese history with the Daily Relics app! Immerse yourself in a world of wonder and curiosity as you explore the exhibits at the National Palace Museum. Engage with carefully selected images of national treasures, complemented by easy-to-understand descriptions. With a fresh theme unveiled every day, the app promises to offer a comprehensive insight into these rare and timeless gems that have stood the test of time.

Throughout the ages, the museum's relics have gracefully embraced the profound legacy of Chinese culture, preserving its heritage of the ancient civilization for thousands of years. The Daily Relics app acts as a bridge across the Taiwan Strait, granting you a glimpse of these extraordinary treasures. So why wait? Embark on a journey of discovery through the wonders of Chinese history and culture – download the app now! Let the Daily Relics app be your gateway to the past, infusing joy and enlightenment into your everyday life!
